FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE
THE order under Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), as amended by Acts, No. 13 of 1966,No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amendedby Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I,Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment do by this Order declare that Halgolla,Udangomuwa, Galgewatta, Alwatta, Karagahalanda, Pallehapuvida, Muwandeniya proposed Reserve Forest of 28.9061hectares bounded by the limit set forth in the schedule 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12 and 13 hereto asHalgolla, Udangomuwa, Galgewatta, Alwatta, Karagahalanda, Pallehapuvida, Muwandeniya Reserved Forest from 04th dayof April, 2018.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment.
Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment,Battaramulla,04th April 2018.
